upstream.description: Open-source intelligence for the global theater. Track everything from the corporate/private jets of the wealthy, and spy satellites, to seismic events in one unified interface. Hook an AI agent up to have it parse through data and find previously unseen correlations. The knowledge is available to all but rarely aggregated in the open, until now.

classification.analysis: ShadowBroker is a self-hosted Next.js/FastAPI OSINT dashboard that aggregates 60+ live public intelligence feeds - aircraft ADS-B, maritime AIS, satellites, earthquakes, CCTV, GPS jamming, mesh/ham radio, Telegram OSINT, and a server-side recon toolkit (DNS/WHOIS/Shodan/CVE) - onto one MapLibre map. It exposes an HMAC-signed agentic command channel so AI agents (Claude, GPT, OpenClaw, etc.) can query and act on the same telemetry as the operator, plus an experimental peer-to-peer InfoNet mesh messaging protocol. Built for OSINT analysts, researchers, and radio operators who want a single self-hosted situational-awareness map with no accounts or third-party telemetry.

use_cases.title: Self-host a real-time OSINT and geospatial situational-awareness dashboard
Connect an AI agent to query and act on live telemetry
Run server-side recon like DNS, WHOIS, Shodan, and CVE lookups safely
